newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv says parent stake diluted.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv says parent stake diluted.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said the shareholding of its parent in the company will be diluted to 35.71 percent from 46.85 percent after a share subscription and placement announced on Thursday.

Its parent Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd agreed to place 320 million existing Guangzhou Investment shares at HK$3.98 each and to subscribe the same number of new sahres from the company at the same price, it said in a statement on Friday.
Guangzhou Invesment also said it will reimburse Yue Xiu about HK$28 million for placing and subscription expenses.

The net proceeds of about HK$1.24 billion raised would be used to acquire hotels and for property investment and development business with the remaining balance as general working capital of the group, Guangzhou Investment said.
But concrete terms on the purchases have not yet been finalised and a further announcement will be made when appropiate, it said. -- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6369
